get_eval_config_and_method: extract evaluation configuration and method from a config dictionary for CSD or pymatgen
ccdc_match_settings: configure CCDC PackingSimilarity settings with shell size, hydrogen ignoring, and molecular difference options
match_structures: compare a single predicted crystal structure against experimental references using CSD or pymatgen
load_target_structures: load experimental reference structures from CIF files into a dictionary keyed by reference code
compute_structure_matches: run structure matching evaluation on all predicted crystal structures using CSD or pymatgen methods
